actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in this analytics dashboard project — the scope and timeline sound like a good fit.

Quick notes on fit and next steps:
- I can implement real-time visualizations (D3.js or Recharts/Visx depending on needs), integrate with your REST API, add role-based auth, and deliver a responsive tablet/desktop UI with dark mode.
- Your stated budget of $5k–$6k and ~4-week timeline is reasonable for an MVP that includes core visualizations, auth, and responsive UI. I can provide a more detailed estimate after clarifying requirements.

A few questions to scope the work precisely:
1) Do you have API docs or example endpoints (WebSocket or polling) and sample payloads for the metrics? Estimated data volume and update frequency will affect architecture.
2) How many user roles and what permissions are required? Any SSO (SAML/OAuth) needs?
3) Are there design assets or a style guide to match (or should I propose designs)?
4) Expected hosting/CI environment (AWS, GCP, on-prem) and any security/compliance constraints?
5) Preferred charting library (you mentioned D3.js — open to alternatives if you want faster dev/maintainability).

If you’re available, I’d be happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through requirements and finalize milestones. I’m available Mon–Thu 10:00–15:00 CT next week — let me know a time that works for you and a calendar link, or I can send availability.

If that sounds good I’ll prepare a proposed timeline, milestones, and a fixed-cost proposal to match your budget.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing more.

Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer / Full-Stack Developer
